doc: Eldreda Sunbringer (Eldreda.pmx, H:\BACKUP_20260815\Modding\ipg\zzz_33_c\output\eldreda_sunbringer\1_PMX\Eldreda), in game as sheepylord's compiled addon (models/sheepylord/zenless_zone_zero/eldreda_sunbringer.mdl, a ragdoll; rpai --mdl), reviewed 2026-10-27: aggressive style (the user's choice for the recent batches). 19 materials on 5 sheets, 2048 DXT in game, all 5 hashes live (offline prediction 5/5). face.png and hair.png are byte-identical to Eldreda Alt's (eldredacasual_9345b723) and this layer, sorting first, owns them for both. skin.png is skin only and left to Remix. body.png is the single Bodysuit material (#0; it took skin from the texture name 体 -> body), pinned to cloth and split by island and colour, in order: champagne-gold islands (ornaments, buckles, boot stars, diamonds; >= 50% of texels hue 12-48, sat 0.12-0.70, val >= 0.5) become metal; the gold meander trim and studs painted on the suit become metal per texel; the silver four-point hip star and the four collar discs (rectangles) metal; gloves and gauntlets, both collar plates, the dark chest star and the red enamel hip badge become leather (a hard glossy coat: rpai has no plastic class and leather's aggressive values, 0.20 and normal 2.0, suit lacquered armour); every island centred below 4.3 units (the boots) leather; last, the pale centres of the gold crosses and the white grommets metal. Black and blue suit panels and the mesh sleeve stay cloth. clothes.png (Cape #2): cloth, including the ochre quilted lining panels (stitched diamond quilting: fabric, not gold); the gold medallion on the back and the gold ring and diamond on the red collar (rectangles) and the silver discs and stars (whole islands) metal. hair.png: Hair and Bangs hair; Horns (#5) and HairOrnament (#6) pinned to leather (dark mechanical head gear: screws, scratches, carbon weave, red LED dots), their peach horn tips metal and the faceted peach crystal gem; Earrings (#7, dark grey stars) metal by pin (gunmetal). face.png: anime-safe face classes; MouthInside (#11) pinned to mouth (same values as face), EyeHighlight 1-3 (#15-17, catchlight meshes that the English names did not match) pinned to highlight; EyeShadow stays face. Metal F0 measured on the mesh (median linear luminance): suit gold 0.32, cape medallion 0.47, horn tips 0.60, silver parts 0.24-0.27, earrings 0.04: painted mid-tones, so satin metal (0.30) per the gold-type standard; no f0 lift (only the Robins carry it, at the user's request). Published 2026-10-27 (4 overrides, 16 DDS) and measured in game: bracketed AABB A/B/A2, 5 views, repeat noise 0.3-1.9/255, drift A2-A 3.4-8.7 frame mean; B against the mean of A and A2: gauntlet +13% (brightest 10% 82 -> 113), boot leather +12%, black suit +11%, blue panel +10%, gold zipper -17%, gold leg trim -14%, boot gold star -25%, tan toe caps -7%, collar discs -19%, iris +44 levels (eye standard); face, bare leg skin, hair and floor within drift.
